description: This file is a Streamlit web app page for uploading, processing, and managing PDF chapters related to medical textbooks. It handles file uploads, metadata input, PDF processing, embedding generation, storage, and chapter management including deletion.

classes.name: LangchainPDFProcessor
classes.description: Processor class for extracting text chunks from PDF files using Langchain.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: Manager class for generating text embeddings asynchronously.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: Local storage class for managing vector embeddings and associated chunks.

methods.name: process_pdf
methods.description: Method to process a PDF file and extract text chunks.

methods.name: batch_embed
methods.description: Asynchronous method to generate embeddings for a batch of texts.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Load existing embeddings or data from storage.

methods.name: add_embeddings
methods.description: Add new embeddings and associated chunks to the vector store.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persist the current state of the vector store.

methods.name: cascade_delete_chapter
methods.description: Function to delete a chapter and all related data including questions, attempts, conversations, and embeddings.
